name: palate-classic
description: Palate classic: the 1.16 builder, frozen. Use one Palate plugin at a time. Builds and maintains production-grade Astro websites grounded by the Palate MCP: scaffold a new site, or add pages, sections and features to an existing one (CONTINUE mode) with the same taste rigour. Also converts brand assets into a four-format design-token package. Connect the Palate MCP with one `claude mcp add --scope user` command (token from app.palatemcp.com).
